title: Create Wizardry Server
description: The official modpack for the Create Wizardry server.
body:
The official modpack for the Create Wizardry server!
A Forge 1.21.1 Minecraft server where engineering meets magic.

Features

- Create Mod + Addons — build advanced machines, factories, and contraptions

- Iron Spells & Spellbooks — wield powerful magic and combat spells

- Custom Modpack — download from #info, install using Modrinth or CurseForge

Gameplay
Create Wizardry blends automation, magic, and PvP gameplay.
PvP is enabled and looting is allowed, but griefing, base raiding, and killing inside bases are not allowed.
